text: More recently, we have started to study quantum computing. That is how to execute algorithms on quantum computing platforms, and in particular machine learning algorithms on quantum computing platforms. In Turin, Italy, that is my where my university is, we have a quite large lab with 5G cells, private cells, and also edge computing platforms, and then mobile autonomous devices, rovers, and and also vehicles, with which we test our solutions. So, if you are interested in a master thesis project, please consider the possibility to carry out this project in collaboration with Professor here in Turin University. Or if you like to visit Turin, Italy, you are most welcome to come and do your master project there. This is just a picture that represents.
